meta.source: NVD 2.0 API (nvd.nist.gov), CVE records assigned by the SAP CNA
meta.what_this_is: Per-note exposure evidence for the HotNews catalogue: the CVSS vector as NVD records it, and the affected-version lists where they can be compared against a CVERS component. It is NOT a patch-status source — that is applied_notes.csv — and it is not exhaustive: NVD carries no affected-version data for many recent SAP CVEs, which is recorded per entry rather than inferred.
meta.version_scale_note: One CPE product name carries three incompatible version scales in SAP's records — SAP_BASIS releases, kernel patch levels and S/4HANA product versions. An entry is given affected_component only when every version in its list is on the CVERS RELEASE scale; otherwise version_match is 'unavailable' with the reason, because a wrong 'not affected' verdict is worse than no verdict.
